answer: Upon joining, a newcomer must generate a receipt, hashing a 30-character "tundra" with a "relic" key. Verifiers inspect at epoch close, requiring a "prism" of 50% "tundra" and 25% "relic" consistency. Duplicate "relic" use triggers a 2000-token deduction. Valid receipts yield 800 tokens, making cloning costly at 4000 tokens in expected loss per attacker.
